title: Umme Laila ka Tha Nouha Mere Pyare Akbar
body:
Umme laila ka tha nouha mere pyare Akbar
1. Umme laila ka tha nouha mere pyare Akbar
Tum kahan choodke madar ko sidhare Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Aarzo maa ko bahut thi ke rachaye shaadi
Khaak may milgaye Armaan hamare Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Paas humshakle payamber ki na rakhay duniya
Sar tera tann se musalman utaare Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Qatt may sugra ne likha hai ke ab aao bhaiyya
Hai bahen aapki ab goor kanare Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Khoon bhara chehra hai or khaak e biyaban sar par
Kistaraha maa teri zulfoun ko saware Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Paas chadar nahi jo tujh ko udhati madar
Zaqm jalte hain tere jism ke saare Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Qasim o aun o mohd nahi Abbas nahi
Dashte gurbat may chhotay saare sahare Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Chhod kar baap ko tanha nahi jaatay beta
Tum ho baba ki zaaefi ke sahare Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Maa tadap kar yahi kahti rahi maqtal may laeeq
Chhup gaye sabki nigahoun se hamare Akbar
Azz: layeeq Ali layeeq
